title: Methods and Algorithms for Correlation Analysis in R
authors: Makowski, D., Ben-Shachar, M., Patil, I., & Lüdecke, D.
summary: The correlation R package covers the whole family through one function — Pearson, Spearman, Kendall, biserial, polychoric, tetrachoric, partial and Bayesian — choosing the method that suits the variables it is given, and returning matrices that are ready to plot or report.
